pages.title: After the Long Shadow
pages.text: Using the drops turns a victory into useful new technology.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Throw the capsid-made Mysterious Worm into the End void. Focus the head; segments can split the boss. A redstone biting beak and Dimensional Carver use earned trophies, never gifted by the journal.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Defeat Void Worm normally and use its earned material in one utility. Throw the capsid-made Mysterious Worm into the End void. Focus the head; segments can split the boss. A redstone biting beak and Dimensional Carver use earned trophies, never gifted by the journal.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Move an item between inventories with a Capsid and collect a transformed output. Stack capsids above inventories to lift items. They transform selected inputs; a mosquito larva becomes Mysterious Worm for the End boss. Its maggot route can use platypus foraging despite disabled flies.
